newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Btp yield spread vs Bund widens to 151 bps.
newsitem.headline: Italian Btp yield spread vs Bund widens to 151 bps.

text.p: The yield spread of the February 1, 2007 Italian government bond (BTP) widened to 151 basis points over the July 4, 2007 Bund in morning trade, compared with 143 basis points at the start.
The BTP was yielding 7.42 percent at 0920 GMT while the Bund had a yield of 5.95 percent. The BTP was trading 40 basis points down on the day at 96.09.
Traders said bond markets in general were nervous ahead of the second round of voting in French elections, with concerns over the possibility of victory for French Socialists.
Specific to Italy, the market was also edgy ahead of the presentation today of the government's three-year plan of economic targets.
